C1393.title: Paras Jha Ordered to Pay $8.6 Million for Rutgers DDoS Attacks
C1393.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice said Paras Jha repeatedly attacked Rutgers University's network from November 2014 through September 2016, disrupting its central authentication portal and forcing the university to incur incident-response and DDoS-mitigation costs. In October 2018, the court relied on the university's loss documentation to order $8.6 million in restitution, along with home confinement, community service, and supervised release.
